Class Cookie

java.lang.Object
core.entities.base.GameObject
core.entities.base.Cookie
All Implemented Interfaces:
Animatable
Direct Known Subclasses:
BlueberryCookie, BraveGingerbreadCookie, NinjaCookie, PirateCookie, ZombieCookie
public abstract class Cookie extends GameObject implements Animatable
Base class for all playable cookies. Responsibilities: - Handle animation - Handle HP system - Handle movement and physics - Support abilities - Render cookie sprites/effects
